title: AlignPre: Skill-Aligned Post-Training for Latent-Free Generative Precipitation Nowcasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.34101v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Precipitation nowcasting requires accurate short-term predictions under rapidly evolving spatiotemporal dynamics. Generative diffusion models can produce detailed and competitive radar forecasts by modeling conditional distributions. However, most existing approaches rely on separately trained components, such as deterministic branches or latent compression modules. More fundamentally, distribution matching alone fails to explicitly optimize operational forecast skill. We propose AlignPre, a streamlined pixel-space nowcasting framework that bridges this gap via skill-aligned post-training (SAPT). AlignPre employs an end-to-end flow-matching forecaster with a hierarchical spatiotemporal architecture for distribution matching and direct radar-field synthesis, without latent compression. translated_title: AlignPre：面向无潜在压缩生成式降水临近预报的技能对齐后训练
translated_abstract: 降水临近预报需要在快速演变的时空动态下进行准确的短期预测。生成式扩散模型可以通过建模条件分布来产生细致且具有竞争力的雷达预报。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于单独训练的组件，例如确定性分支或潜在压缩模块。更根本的是，仅靠分布匹配无法显式地优化业务预报技能。我们提出了AlignPre，一个精简的像素空间临近预报框架，通过技能对齐后训练（SAPT）来弥合这一差距。AlignPre采用具有层次化时空架构的端到端流匹配预报器，实现分布匹配与直接的雷达场合成，无需潜在压缩。在后训练阶段，SAPT利用预报验证得分的解析结构来构建可微分的目标函数，通过反向传播梯度……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: AlignPre提出了一种无需潜在压缩的像素空间降水临近预报框架，其核心创新是利用预报验证得分的解析结构构建可微分目标进行技能对齐后训练（SAPT），从而直接优化业务预报技能而非仅进行分布匹配。
en_tdlr: AlignPre introduces a streamlined latent-free pixel-space precipitation nowcasting framework whose key innovation, skill-aligned post-training (SAPT), exploits the analytic structure of forecast verification scores to construct differentiable objectives that directly optimize operational forecast skill rather than relying solely on distribution matching.
